fields.why: The Table marks every income and education level as significantly different from each other level (t tests), across 3 ordered SES groups.
Income and education are both SES (3 levels each); the Summary's headline compares SES patterns across 4 race/Hispanic-origin groups, with no test across race.

The marks * (vs <=130%) and dagger (vs middle) show all three income pairs, and likewise for education, so pairwise (all pairs). The race comparison of patterns is untested, so side by side; the flagged linear/quadratic trend tests are over calendar time within SES levels, not across race (rule 4), so the flag is a false hit.
